text:
maria: Heads-up — seeing an alert storm: multiple gpu-utilization-high alerts in us-west-2 + a 6x jump in structured log volume from gpu-pool-3. Feels correlated to a bunch of model-loader restarts.
infra-bot: [ALERT] gpu-utilization-high (us-west-2) — 47 firing, severity=page.
josh: I pulled the Grafana fleet/gpu-health dashboard — spike at 12:04 matched ~80 pod restarts across the pool. Prom query I ran: `sum(rate(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[5m])) by (node)` shows the same.
kevin: The log pipeline autoscaled when the JSON payloads ballooned. We blew past ingestion thresholds — cost dashboard shows ingestion cost +420% in 30m window.
aubrey: Any PII fields in the excess logs? Are we accidentally logging user prompts or full request bodies?
maria: Sample snippet from one of the noisy logs: ```json
{"ts":"2026-03-18T12:03:58Z","level":"info","component":"model-loader","msg":"loaded model","model":"llama-v2","payload":{"user_id":"<redacted>","prompt":"<very long user prompt... repeated>"},"payload_size":123456}```
josh: Oof — payload_size is huge. Short-term: we should silence the noise alert and add a 10m for: `gpu-utilization-high and increase() > 2` so it requires sustained load. Also add a dedupe in Alertmanager to avoid an alert storm.
kevin: Agreed. Medium-term: update structured log schema to include `payload_size` and `scrubbed_fields` metadata. Add a sampling rule: `when payload_size > 10k then sample_rate=0.01` at the forwarder level. Also add an ingestion hook to redact fields named `prompt`, `user_input`, `raw_text`.
aubrey: Can we do the redaction without losing quality telemetry? Need the metrics but not raw texts.
maria: Yep — store `payload_size` and a hashed fingerprint of prompt instead of raw prompt. We can keep `prompt_hash` and a small `prompt_excerpt(<=256)` after redaction.
josh: Quick mitigation I did: silenced `gpu-utilization-high` in us-west-2 for 30m and flipped `RUNTIME_DEBUG_LOG=false` via deploy. Opening a PR to change the alert rule to require 10m sustained and attach a `log_ingest_rate` condition.
oncall-sre: Ack. I'm tailing `gpu-pool-3` logs now. If payloads continue, I'll scale down the log-forwarder replicas to stop the autoscale loop and open a paging runbook.
grafana-bot: Grafana: Alert rule "gpu-utilization-high (us-west-2)" silenced by josh for 30m. Link: https://grafana.internal/r/alerts/5821
kevin: Longer-term suggestion: instrument the forwarder with a `json_payload_bytes` histogram metric exported to Prometheus. That lets us create an SLO for log volume per pod and create a cost burn alert.
aubrey: We should definitely add a budget-burn alert (monthly ingestion > $X) so we can stop runaway cost.
josh: Action items I'll own: PR #3246 change alert rule (canary to us-west-2), PR #3247 add ingestion redaction + sampling, PR #3248 add `json_payload_bytes` exporter + Grafana panel, and update SLO doc: https://wiki.internal/ops/logging-slos. I'll link PRs here when ready.
maria: Thanks — I'll monitor for the next 2h and post status. If anyone sees new spike, ping @oncall-sre. :thumbsup:
